# ToolKiti - AI API & Tool Directory
> Structured, machine-readable API references for AI agents and developers.

## Core Resources
- JSON API: https://toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools (100 APIs, 13 categories)
- Search API: https://toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools/search?q={query}
- Compare API: https://toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools/compare?ids=slug1,slug2
- Detail API: https://toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools/{slug}
- Categories: https://toolkiti.org/api/v1/tools/categories
- Full dataset: https://toolkiti.org/api/data
- AI-optimized index: https://toolkiti.org/api/ai.txt

## Content Pages
- Free API Guide: https://toolkiti.org/free-tier (20 free AI APIs)
- Error Code DB: https://toolkiti.org/error-codes (15 common API errors with curl)
- MCP Servers: https://toolkiti.org/mcp-servers (15 MCP servers)
- Agent Stacks: https://toolkiti.org/agent-stacks (4 production agent templates)
- Blog: https://toolkiti.org/blog (API comparisons & guides)
- Sponsor: https://toolkiti.org/sponsor

## Site Info
- Language: EN/ZH bilingual
- Updated: 2026-08-01
- APIs: 100 across 13 categories
- Code examples: curl, Python, Node.js
- Structured data: JSON-LD on every page
